source_text.body:
Diagnose and clean up a slow Windows PC
Users had Claude connect to Task Manager, diagnose performance problems, and guide them through the fixes to get their computer running well again.
·
Nov 19, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
One commenter said Claude connected directly to Windows Task Manager, diagnosed what was causing the computer’s problems, and then walked them through the cleanup steps to take. In a follow-up, they clarified that Claude did the diagnosis through that direct Task Manager connection, while the person carried out the guided fixes.
How it went
They said the cleanup was complete and that the computer was running quite well again. The thread gives no specifics on what issues Claude found or which repair steps were needed.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that the source only mentions a direct Task Manager connection and guided steps; it does not explain the tool setup or exact actions to reproduce.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
My Windows PC has been running slowly, especially when I [describe, such as starting up or opening many tabs]. Help me diagnose it by walking me through what to check in Task Manager, such as CPU, memory, disk and startup apps, and tell me what each reading means. Then give me step-by-step fixes ranked by impact, and ask me to confirm before any step that deletes files or uninstalls software.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xzvltr/non_coders_what_are_you_using_claude_for
